sponsor_decisions.rationale: Sponsor accepted 1M rows / 54.68 MiB input, peak process RSS 805.59 MiB (39.34 percent of observed 2 GiB). The original 75 percent benchmark was NOT reached, no failure/OOM boundary observed, and the original BLOCKED diagnostic result is unchanged. No further escalation required for current POC.

Authenticated customer-owned public Blob endpoint proved checkpoint write/readback and reconstruction. Public does not mean anonymous. Private endpoints/network placement and BYO platform stores remain untested, not equivalent or proven.
Approval is tied to the exact original PNG SHA-256 and expected category/revenue values. Larger-size PNG checks were structural only, not additional human chart reviews.

Supported trusted nested caller/session/file contract and smallest stateless adapter require explicit approval. Do not bypass identity guards or create a fourth agent. Historical results are not a combined rerun on v9.

traceability.requirement: 1. Overview: code execution and sandbox state
traceability.summary: Distinguishes Hosted session compute/filesystem from managed Code Interpreter and customer-owned checkpoints
traceability.limitations: Platform architecture guidance is not itself a test result
traceability.next_step: Use the scoped evidence below; do not infer RAM survival from filesystem continuity

traceability.requirement: 2. Data Analysis Agent deployed as a Foundry Hosted Agent
traceability.summary: Existing native Data Analysis v9 passed refreshed readiness; Supervisor v14 and Research v9 remained the same three agents
traceability.limitations: No remaining readiness gap; native and historical toolbox baselines are distinct
traceability.next_step: Refresh Step 1 only after a future deployment/version change

traceability.requirement: 3. Synthetic tabular data, no customer data
traceability.summary: Seeded CSVs from 1k through 1M rows passed checksum and independent-oracle checks
traceability.limitations: Coverage is the fixed synthetic CSV workload, not arbitrary customer datasets or XLSX
traceability.next_step: No additional fixture work required for the accepted POC

traceability.requirement: 4. Filter, group, summarize, analyze with code execution
traceability.summary: Native v8 Step 2 model-written analysis passed; v9 size runs through 1M passed row/cell/group/integer-cents checks
traceability.limitations: General-purpose analytics beyond the selected case is not claimed
traceability.next_step: Preserve the oracle and version-bound evidence; no blanket Step 2 rerun is pending

traceability.summary: Native v8's representative chart received user approval tied to its original hash; v9 size-run PNG originals passed structural checks
traceability.limitations: Larger-case PNGs were not additional human chart-meaning reviews
traceability.next_step: Review new chart meanings only if the scope requires them; do not equate PNG validity with semantic approval

traceability.requirement: 4b. Output delivery to the Supervisor or user
traceability.summary: Native user delivery returns authorized original CSV/PNG session files; v8 two-user owner/foreign controls passed
traceability.limitations: Supervisor lacks the trusted native session/file contract. Long-term output archiving is deferred; a Blob checkpoint is not a full artifact archive
traceability.next_step: Approve the minimal stateless Supervisor adapter and validate its authorized end-to-end file delivery

traceability.requirement: 5. Progressively larger datasets to exercise memory pressure
traceability.summary: All approved sizes through 1M rows / 54.68 MiB input passed; highest process peak was 805.59 MiB, 39.34% of the observed 2 GiB limit
traceability.limitations: The original 75% target and an OOM/failure boundary were not reached; the sponsor explicitly accepted this measured envelope
traceability.next_step: No further pressure escalation for the current POC; preserve the original diagnostic verdict and limitation

traceability.summary: Native measurements, fixed ceilings, failed/partial runs, SDK lifecycle snapshots, and acceptance decisions are recorded with version/run bindings
traceability.limitations: Historical toolbox runtime/network/4g-option findings are not automatically native findings or resolved platform discrepancies
traceability.next_step: Keep bindings current and retain original evidence; no broad retest is pending

traceability.summary: Direct native analysis/user delivery is viable in the accepted tested envelope; scoped isolation and both recovery tracks have evidence
traceability.limitations: A combined conclusion including Supervisor delivery is still pending; production multi-tenant certification is outside scope
traceability.next_step: Finalize per-workload/per-delivery-path viability after the Supervisor result or explicit deferral

traceability.requirement: 8. Secured code execution: where the sandbox runs
traceability.summary: Python executes in managed Code Interpreter, not a local fallback; v8 native application/session isolation passed with two genuine Consumer callers
traceability.limitations: This does not establish privileged project-user native-file confidentiality. Hyper-V/ACA implementation is documented, not physically verified by the POC
traceability.next_step: Preserve owner/session guards and review effective role context before future authorization-sensitive changes

traceability.requirement: 8a. Access to ACA dynamic sessions or an ACA sandbox
traceability.summary: Managed Code Interpreter already uses Microsoft's documented execution service; no customer session pool is needed for this POC
traceability.limitations: Customer-managed ACA/custom interpreter is not provisioned and is intentionally outside the current scope
traceability.next_step: No new infrastructure; revisit only for an approved runtime/network/compute requirement

traceability.summary: Native v8 Blob write/readback and recomputation passed in a new binding/interpreter; v9 Hosted active/idle/active metadata, changed process, and retained HOME sentinel passed
traceability.limitations: These separate proofs do not establish native interpreter RAM survival, indefinite storage, or full crash/fault recovery
